description: Reconcile the author attribution for Another Look at Mandaic Incantation Bowl BM 91715: existing SRC-1EE58A703971 names Christa Müller-Kessler, while the JANES volume 29 and article pages name J. N. Ford.
resolution_notes: Resolved 6 September 2026. The journal and Bar-Ilan institutional publication record identify J. N. Ford. SRC-1EE58A703971 was an OpenAlex metadata artifact, not the article itself; it is now classified as repository metadata and its exact prior state is preserved in IBI-SOURCE-CORR-FORD2002-ATTRIBUTION. The correctly attributed SRC-FORD2002-JANES appearance is attached to BM 91715. Full-text access remains a separate blocked lead.
